source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Errata to [Cabal of Sorcerers](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.cabal-of-sorcerers): its first paragraph and 3 Rituals change.

With a **THOUSAND SONS** Army Faction, as your Shooting phase starts, models of yours with this ability may attempt Rituals. For each attempt, pick a model of yours that has this ability and has made no Ritual attempt yet this turn, and a Ritual that no model in your army has tried to manifest in this turn. Then the model takes a Psychic test.

The changed Rituals each pick a unit **visible** to and within 24″ of the manifesting model:

- **Destiny’s Ruin**: pick an enemy unit; until the phase ends, a **Hit roll** of 1 for an attack against it by your **THOUSAND SONS** or **SCINTILLATING LEGIONS** models may be re-rolled, or any Hit roll if the test result was 10+.
- **Twist of Fate**: pick an enemy unit; until the phase ends, attacks against it by your **THOUSAND SONS** or **SCINTILLATING LEGIONS** models improve their AP by 1, or by 2 if the test result was 12+.
- **Temporal Surge**: pick a friendly **unengaged** **THOUSAND SONS** or **SCINTILLATING LEGIONS** unit; it may move up to D6″ with a **Normal move**, or up to 6″ if the test result was 10+, and either way cannot declare a charge this turn.
